_comment: Protocol and definitional constants. These are facts with sources, not tunable assumptions: nothing in the UI edits them, and no chart depends on a number that is not either on-chain, from the market feed, or listed here.

emission.source: Pearl whitepaper: E(t) = S·H/((t+H)(t+H−1)), cumulative S·t/(t+H), 194s target, WTEMA N=2016. Genesis time is the timestamp of block #1 on chain.
emission.supplyBaselineNote: Ingestion starts at #99,000, so cumulative supply is seeded with S·t/(t+H) at that height and then accumulates observed coinbase subsidies. The seed is the whitepaper curve evaluated at a height, not an estimate.

hashrate.source: H = D · 2^48 / T with T the observed average block time. Reproduces HeroMiners (25.78 EH/s) and AlphaPool (25.78 EH/s) at block #111,716 to within a few percent. Pool dashboards quote difficulty at 65,536× the node value.

market.source: CoinGecko daily close for id pearl-2. Used only where a chart is explicitly denominated in USD.
